user_story: As a user I can switch between calculation tabs from the top navigation.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Clicking a tab changes the active mode and renders the selected lazy-loaded module inside ErrorBoundary/Suspense.
notes: Browser smoke on local production build passed on 2026-07-28 for all seven tabs; no console errors.

user_story: As a user I see a loading state when a heavy calculation module is loading.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: LazyTab wraps children in Suspense and shows a small loading fallback while the module chunk loads.
notes: Automated app infrastructure contract test passed on 2026-06-22; heavy generated modules should remain outside startup chunk.

user_story: As a user a failed module should not crash the whole app.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: ErrorBoundary catches tab errors, logs technical details, shows a Russian error message, optional message detail, and retry button.
notes: Automated app infrastructure contract test passed on 2026-06-22; browser-level retry click can still be covered in a future E2E pass.

user_story: As a user I can see the shared building inputs while working across modules.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: BuildingSummaryBanner displays shared span, length, height, slope, frame pitch, w0, Sg, terrain, roof and gamma values.
notes: GitHub Pages smoke on 2026-06-22 confirmed shared building banner/context text is present.

user_story: As a user I get warnings near invalid shared numeric inputs.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Synced numeric fields validate positive/non-negative values and show local warnings without silently hiding calculation failures.
notes: Automated validation tests passed on 2026-06-22; manual visual placement still can be checked in UI pass.

user_story: As a user I can search and select a city without loading climate JSON in startup bundle.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: City search uses async service with debounced search and dynamic import of settlements climate JSON; selected city fills terrain, w0 and Sg where applicable.
notes: Automated app infrastructure contract test passed on 2026-06-22; previous manual smoke confirmed Chelyabinsk fills climate values.

user_story: As a user I can view selected profiles for edge, fachwerk and middle columns based on current inputs.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: ColumnApp recomputes runCalculation for column types and publishes picked results to shared summary bus.
notes: Automated column acceptance tests and feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22; no formulas changed.

user_story: As a user I can mark overhead/suspended crane presence in the column module.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Column crane inputs update shared hasCrane state through hasColumnCrane; crane status affects summary and crane beam readiness.
notes: Automated crane flag tests and feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22; if no crane, crane beam is not required.

user_story: As a user I can see loads propagated from truss and crane beam into the column context.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: LoadPropagationBanner shows truss reactions and crane beam publication when available.
notes: Feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22; H remains not calculated/not confirmed as zero.

user_story: As a user I can see how many column struts are included in the summary row.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Column result details show struts per column and total struts; strut mass/cost is included in column group totals.
notes: Automated column publisher tests passed on 2026-06-22; material is documented as tr.kv.80x4 C255B, summary shows quantity only.

user_story: As a user I can calculate roof truss profiles and see section results.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: TrussApp recomputes runTrussCalculation from synced building inputs and publishes truss sections, total mass, cost, unit mass and reactions.
notes: Automated truss acceptance tests, UI warning contract and feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22.

user_story: As a user I am warned that horizontal reaction H is an open engineering question.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Truss UI displays warning that H is not found in the Excel-oracle, is not passed into column calculation as a number, and is not a confirmed H = 0 assumption.
notes: Automated UI warning contract test passed on 2026-06-22; do not hide this warning.

user_story: As a user I can calculate purlins with LSTK and rolled candidates.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: PurlinApp runs runPurlinCalculation and rolled selection, then publishes selected purlin result according to purlinSelectionMode.
notes: Automated purlin acceptance/selection tests and feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22.

user_story: As a user I can choose Auto, 2TPS, 2PS, Z or rolled purlin type where allowed.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Available choices depend on roof structure; 2TPS is only available for roof structures starting with 'наше '.
notes: Automated purlin selection tests passed on 2026-06-22; rule confirmed by user: 2TPS only for layer-by-layer roof assembly.

user_story: As a user I can choose split or continuous purlin accounting.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Split uses bay length and larger piece count; continuous uses building length and line count.
notes: Automated purlin selection tests passed on 2026-06-22; this affects summary quantity and length only.

user_story: As a user I can constrain automatic purlin max step like in Excel.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Purlin input includes maxStep_mm and engine acceptance tests cover max step scenarios including 1200 mm.
notes: Automated purlin acceptance tests passed on 2026-06-22; manual UI label check remains for UI pass.

user_story: As a user I see the temporary axial wind load warning for purlins.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Purlin UI keeps visible warning about temporary axial wind load assumption for rolled purlins.
notes: Found corrupted placeholder warning text in PurlinApp; restored visible Russian warning and added automated UI warning contract test on 2026-06-22.

user_story: As a user I can calculate roof beam / beam-cell result for summary.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: BeamCellApp calculates main beam in roof beam mode, derives roof slope length and publishes selected main beam result.
notes: Automated beam-cell acceptance and summary contract tests passed on 2026-06-22.

user_story: As a user I can calculate lower/upper window riegel profile options from Excel-backed workbook.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: WindowRiegelApp runs calculateWindowRiegel, displays lower/upper and upper-type-1 tables, and publishes top result for summary.
notes: Browser smoke on 2026-07-28 found literal #N/A rows and a terrain-label mismatch between tab and summary. UI now hides only Excel-error rows; both paths use shared A/B/C to А/В/С adapter. Workbook generated files were not edited.

user_story: As a user I can set the number of window riegels used in the building summary.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: windowRiegelCount is a shared building field; publisher multiplies unit mass and cost by count and summary warns that count is manual.
notes: Automated window-riegel summary tests passed on 2026-06-22; future facade model should replace manual count.

user_story: As a user I should only calculate crane beam when crane is enabled.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: CraneBeamRunner refuses calculation when building.hasCrane is false; Summary marks crane beam not required if no crane.
notes: Automated readiness tests passed on 2026-06-22; manual button behavior remains for UI pass.

user_story: As a user I can run slow crane beam calculation without freezing startup.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: CraneBeamRunner dynamically imports craneBeam engine and publishes result with count, length, mass and details.
notes: Automated app infrastructure contract test passed on 2026-06-22; dynamic import remains intact.

user_story: As a user I can open Summary and get results without visiting every tab.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: SummaryApp automatically runs calculateBuildingResultsForSummary on open if results are stale or missing.
notes: Core calculation and stale-key tests passed; browser smoke on 2026-07-28 confirmed summary produces results without visiting each tab.

user_story: As a user I can manually recalculate all summary results after changing parameters.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Button 'Рассчитать всё для сводки' runs core modules, publishes results and shows module errors if any.
notes: Core orchestration tests passed; the button was clicked in browser smoke on 2026-07-28 and refreshed matching window-riegel result without console errors.

user_story: As a user I can see whether the summary is complete.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: Readiness block shows ready/missing/not-required for columns, truss, purlins, roof beam, window riegels and crane beam.
notes: Automated readiness tests passed on 2026-06-22; no-crane crane beam is not marked missing.

user_story: As a user I can inspect selected profiles, quantities, lengths, mass and cost by element.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: buildSummaryRows renders rows for columns, truss, purlins, beam cell, window riegels and crane beam with totals.
notes: Automated summary row contract tests passed on 2026-06-22; column breakdown can create multiple rows by length.

user_story: As a user I can see total mass and cost by steel grade.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: calculateBuildingSummaryTotalsBySteel aggregates item totals and splits truss cost by section mass.
notes: Automated summary totals tests passed on 2026-06-22; totals match selected element inputs in tests.

user_story: As a user I can see truss mass broken down by VP/NP/ORb/OR/RR sections.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: SummaryApp renders separate truss section table when truss result has sections.
notes: Feature user story contract and summary/truss publisher tests passed on 2026-06-22.

user_story: As a user I can inspect column counts by frame/end/fachwerk logic.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: SummaryApp shows detailed count diagnostics based on unified building layout and GIP rule.
notes: Automated column count summary tests and feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22; GIP rule remains documented in knowledge.

user_story: As a user I can choose purlin type and split/continuous scheme directly in Summary.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: BuildingBlock in Summary exposes purlinSelectionMode and purlinContinuityScheme controls and updates shared building context.
notes: Automated purlin selection/key tests and feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22.

user_story: As a maintainer I can find project rules, module docs, assumptions and parity sources.
expected_behavior_based_on_code: knowledge/ contains README, AGENTS, wiki modules, parity notes, decisions, tasks, raw source registry and lint notes.
notes: Feature user story contract test passed on 2026-06-22 for canonical knowledge entry points.

expected_behavior_based_on_code: knowledge/raw/.gitignore blocks heavy/confidential raw sources while keeping README, gitkeep and source-register.
notes: Automated raw source guard tests passed on 2026-06-22; generated files are a separate concern.

expected_behavior_based_on_code: public assets and generated metadata tests guard expected public files such as favicon/manifest if present.
